summary: Israel Acquisitions Corp (IAC), a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its business combination agreement with Gadfin Ltd., an Israeli drone logistics company, originally entered January 26, 2025 and amended multiple times. No deal terms are disclosed—no price, premium, or fees. The transaction structure involved IAC and Gadfin becoming subsidiaries of a new Israeli holding company, Gadfin Regev Holdings Ltd., via two mergers. Termination occurred June 22, 2026 by mutual agreement or per contractual termination rights. As a SPAC that failed to consummate a de-SPAC, IAC now faces liquidation or a new search; the OTC-listed units, shares, and warrants will likely trade on dissolution value.
